instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'Arte Bianca' warm flour & wood color scheme (#FDFBF7, #FAF5EC, #8C4A27, #D97706). Remove all generic blue/gold or white mixer backgrounds.
Do NOT mention any prices or the word 'Gratis'. Use dynamic challenge CTAs: 'Sblocca Contenuto', 'Completa la Sfida per Accedere', 'Guadagna la Scheda'.
Ensure the Home page displays the 6 sections in the exact requested order.
B2B section must be clean with 3 key pillars (Spazi, Tempi/Flussi, Riduzione Sprechi) and ONE single CTA 'Genera Piano di Lavoro e Avvia Sblocco'.
Keep interactive Michele & Mohamed Avatar Guide clean, step-by-step, and fully functional in Italian with multi-language fallback.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Maintain high contrast APCA standards across all flour-toned containers.
Do not use transparent backgrounds under header, dropdowns, or modals.
Use subtle spring animations and micro-interactions on challenge unlock cards.
Always test interface in Italian as primary language.
